section.hero.title: Data structures
section.hero.subtitle: Stacks
section.hero.paragraph: A stack is a linear LIFO structure: the last element in is the first element out. Explore its behaviour, push values and watch how the array and the CIMA variable change.

section.pila.title: Stack
section.pila.paragraph: Operate on the stack and see how the memory cells and the CIMA variable change in real time.

errors.PILA_LLENA: The stack is full: no more elements can be pushed.
errors.PILA_VACIA: The stack is empty: there is nothing to pop.
errors.VALOR_INVALIDO: The value must be an integer between 1 and 99.
errors.CANTIDAD_INVALIDA: The stack cannot hold more than 6 elements.
errors.sin_historial: There is no previous state to go back to.
